# HarfBuzz font fixture

`Roboto-Regular.ttf` is copied unchanged from `perf/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf`
at HarfBuzz revision `ff36703b95013ec1d437e6038e1aa7c881275f4e`, as pinned in
PDFium `f51279699cb59754d1f49aef10eb8e825fe56532`'s DEPS. That external
checkout is absent from the read-only PDFium source tree in this repository.
The native `FxSkrifaTest.TestRobotoGlyph167Bounds` uses this exact fixture.

Source: https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/ff36703b95013ec1d437e6038e1aa7c881275f4e/perf/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf

SHA-256: `797e35f7f5d6020a5c6ea13b42ecd668bcfb3bbc4baa0e74773527e5b6cb3174`
